id: 12_Laboratory Safety Comprehensive Electrical Hazard Awareness Training Course
title: 电气危害：认得清，躲得开
source_doc: course/Lab Safety Training - Essential Protocols/12_Laboratory Safety Comprehensive Electrical Hazard Awareness Training Course.md
author_source: project/Lab Safety Training - Essential Protocols/12_Laboratory Safety Comprehensive Electrical Hazard Awareness Training Course/src.py

points.K6: 以国家共识标准为基础
points.K7: 合格人员和非合格人员
points.K8: 专业组织的设计安装维护规范

shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验台旁，台上有几台仪器和插线板
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a lab bench with several instruments and a power strip, waving at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲：认清电气危害。
overlay: 电气危害：认得清，躲得开

shots.scene: 闪电警示、培训、标准文本三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons in a row: a lightning warning sign, a training class and a stack of blank standard booklets. No people.
shots.narration: 危害有多重，培训防什么，标准怎么定。

shots.scene: 阿杰拿起一台仪器，随手就要插电
shots.prompt_en: The young male student picks up a small instrument and casually reaches to plug it in.
shots.narration: 阿杰觉得，插个电而已，有什么好学的。

shots.scene: 小研摇摇头，指着墙上的闪电警示标志
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student shakes her head and points at an electrical warning sign on the wall.
shots.narration: 小研说：电的事，可一点不简单。

shots.scene: 触电图标和受伤的人形图标
shots.prompt_en: An electric shock warning sign next to an injured person icon with a bandage. No people.
shots.narration: 电伤害是一种复杂的创伤，

shots.scene: 多个行业图标上都有闪电警示
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a factory, a lab and a construction site, each with a lightning warning mark. No people.
shots.narration: 在很多行业里，致残率和死亡率都很高。

shots.scene: 日历翻页，每页都有一个闪电警示
shots.prompt_en: Calendar pages flipping, each page marked with a small lightning warning symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 据美国劳工统计局数据，

shots.scene: 2017年日历和一个数字牌
shots.prompt_en: A calendar page for one year next to a blank counter board with a lightning icon. No people.
shots.narration: 2017年因电导致的工伤死亡有136人。

shots.scene: 王老师在培训教室讲课，屏幕空白
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator teaches a training class in front of a blank screen; the young male student listens.
shots.narration: 为此，美国职业安全卫生管理局要求培训，

shots.scene: 触电、电击、电弧、爆炸、火灾五个图标
shots.prompt_en: Five icons in a row: a lightning bolt with a person, a shock symbol, an arc flash, an explosion and a flame. No people.
shots.narration: 防触电死亡、电击、电弧、爆炸和火灾。

shots.scene: 放大镜照着电线和插座
shots.prompt_en: A magnifying glass icon over a power cord and a wall outlet. No people.
shots.narration: 电气安全计划，帮员工识别电气危害，

shots.scene: 人形图标绕开闪电区域走
shots.prompt_en: A person icon walking around a zone marked with a lightning bolt, with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 并避开它，降低电气伤害的风险。

shots.scene: 盾牌图标护住一个拿着工具的人形
shots.prompt_en: A shield icon protecting a person icon holding electrical tools. No people.
shots.narration: 监管部门执行电气标准，保护作业人员。

shots.scene: 检查、安装、操作、维护四个图标连成一圈
shots.prompt_en: Four icons connected in a circle: a magnifying glass, a wrench, a power button and an oil can. No people.
shots.narration: 涵盖设备的检查、安装、操作和维护。

shots.section_title: 以国家共识标准为基础
shots.scene: 一摞空白标准文本
shots.prompt_en: A stack of blank standard booklets with a plain seal. No people.
shots.narration: 这些规定以国家共识标准为基础，
overlay: 以国家共识标准为基础

shots.section_title: 以国家共识标准为基础
shots.scene: 两本标准书并排
shots.prompt_en: Two blank standard books side by side, one with a plug icon and one with a worker icon. No people.
shots.narration: 比如美国国家电气规范、工作场所电气安全标准。

shots.section_title: 以国家共识标准为基础
shots.scene: 标准文本旁出现勾选清单
shots.prompt_en: A blank checklist with green checks appearing beside the booklets. No people.
shots.narration: 它们规定了必要的做法和程序。

shots.section_title: 合格人员和非合格人员
shots.scene: 一本空白法规书翻开到某一节
shots.prompt_en: A blank regulation book opened to a section with a bookmark. No people.
shots.narration: 比如美国联邦法规1910.331到335条，
overlay: 合格人员和非合格人员

shots.section_title: 合格人员和非合格人员
shots.scene: 合格电工和非合格人员两个人形
shots.prompt_en: Two person icons: a qualified electrician with a tool bag and a certificate, and an unqualified worker with a pipette. No people.
shots.narration: 对合格和非合格人员，分别规定了做法。

shots.section_title: 专业组织的设计安装维护规范
shots.scene: 两个专业学会的空白徽章图标
shots.prompt_en: Two blank professional society emblem icons side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 美国消防协会和电气电子工程师学会，
overlay: 专业组织的设计安装维护规范

shots.section_title: 专业组织的设计安装维护规范
shots.scene: 图纸、安装、扳手三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a blueprint, an installation tool and a wrench. No people.
shots.narration: 为设计、安装、维护提供全面指导。

shots.scene: 一本空白标准书发着光
shots.prompt_en: A single blank standard book glowing brightly on a stand. No people.
shots.narration: 其中领先的工作场所电气安全标准，

shots.scene: 电弧闪光图标
shots.prompt_en: An arc flash icon bursting from a switch box. No people.
shots.narration: 重点在预防电弧，

shots.scene: 电流穿过人体的示意图被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of current passing through a person's body from hand to foot, crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 以及预防电击。后面再细讲。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现闪电和受伤图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a lightning bolt and an injured person.
shots.narration: 电伤害很重，每年都有人因此丧命。

shots.scene: 培训和标准两个打勾图标
shots.prompt_en: Two icons with green checks: a training class and a stack of standard booklets. No people.
shots.narration: 培训会识别、会避开，标准防电弧电击。

shots.scene: 欣欣举起一个插头竖起大拇指，挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a healthy plug, gives a thumbs-up and waves goodbye.
shots.narration: 认得清，躲得开，下次见！
